bound: For an object with m keys, a root-to-leaf BTreeMap lookup scans keys within visited nodes, with one ordering comparison per tested key. Each node is visited once and node key sets are disjoint, so at most m keys can be compared. The implementation charges max(m, 1) edges before get; the empty case pays one for its empty check. This is an upper bound, not an executed-count assertion.
separateSortedSlicePolicy: D4-1 binary-search prices remain unchanged; they do not price BTreeMap get.

lateKeyControl.expected: All three late-key lookups fund at nine; eight refuses before get with no partial charge and a latched ledger. The version lookup can compare all nine keys in the pinned single-leaf case.

mutation: lookup-underpriced restores the former five-edge sorted-slice price and must fail the late-key control at runtime.
